name: kbd
summary: Shows a keyboard key or shortcut, such as ⌘K beside the search pill or Esc in a dialog footer.
useWhen: A control has a keyboard shortcut worth teaching, such as ⌘K to open search.
A hint tells people which key closes or confirms something.

alternatives.name: badge
alternatives.when: the label is a status or tag, not a key

rules.do: Put each key in its own Kbd inside a KbdGroup, such as ⌘ and K.
rules.dont: Write a whole sentence of shortcuts inside one key.

a11y: Uses the semantic <kbd> element; screen readers read the key names in place.
Shortcut hints are decorative to pointer users, so never make one the only way to find a feature.
